title: Fleet Efficiency Playbook: autoscale tuning & right-size recommendations
creator: Liam O'Connell
description: Create a cross-functional playbook and implementation work to reduce wasted spend across Redwood Dedicated fleets by: 1) producing per-pool right-size recommendations using historical utilization and SLOs, 2) adding a utilization reporting view and alerting signals in Console, and 3) extending autoscale policy primitives so operators can express throughput guarantees + cost headroom. Goal: 10-20% cost reduction on medium-utilization pools without impacting p95 latency SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: Generate automated right-size suggestions for each dedicated pool (recommended commit GPU count + expected cost delta) based on 90-day utilization and peak-hour SLO modeling.
Exposed Console view showing 7/30/90-day utilization, peak concurrency distribution, and recommended target commit with rationale link.
Autoscale policy extensions implemented: 'min_commit', 'throughput_floor', 'scale_buffer_pct', and 'stabilization_window' available via API and Console UI.
Regression tests and a capacity simulator run show <1% risk of SLO violation for recommended downsizes under historical replay and synthetic spike tests.
Rollout plan documented: canary on non-production pools, gradual opt-in in Console, and a rollback safe path.
Monitoring: Grafana dashboard panels added and unit economics report that measures cost per 1k tokens pre/post-change over 30 days.
Design sign-off for Console UX and Engineering review for runtime changes completed.
tasks: Data: build nightly job to compute per-pool utilization histograms and p50/p90/p99 concurrent requests - owner: Maya Chen

Runtime: add autoscale policy fields and enforcement in allocator (min_commit, throughput_floor, scale_buffer_pct) - owner: Priya Nair
Console: add Right-Size Recommendation panel and autoscale policy editor, enable opt-in rollout - owner: Sofia Martinez
Simulator: integrate recommended commit into capacity simulator and run 30-day historical replay + stress tests - owner: Ben Wallace
QA/Performance: run p95/p99 latency regression matrix across model families and quantization profiles - owner: QA Team
Docs: publish playbook + runbook for SREs and CS with rollback steps and customer communication templates - owner: Tomoki Saito
